long_biography.plain_text:
Jean-Charles Decaux went to Spain in 1989 to develop the outdoor advertising business established by his father. An early street-furniture contract in Zaragoza helped launch a career building JCDecaux subsidiaries across Southern Europe, Asia, South America and the Middle East. After the group's acquisition of Avenir, he also led its airport and specialist advertising operations in France.

Decaux has shared the listed group's leadership with his brother Jean-François for decades. They alternate as chairman of its executive board while using the title of co-chief executive. The family remains its controlling shareholder, and Jean-Charles also holds shares directly. Beyond the group, he chairs the supervisory board of investment company Eurazeo.
